text: The initiative features a competitive and transparent procurement process with documented deadline extensions to improve bid quality and competition. It emphasizes localization by awarding the coordinator role to a PNG-based contractor and aligns with the regional BSRP II framework to ensure coherence. The phased approach begins with securing national coordination and institutional presence, followed by provisioning technical infrastructure to enable multi-hazard early warning operations.

metadata.solution_name: Equipment procurement for the Papua New Guinea National Multi-Hazard Early Warning Centre (N-EWC)
